name: Chart Scrub
description: A revenue card draws its area chart with a glowing tip while the headline counts up, then a hairline scrubs the curve with a live tooltip and the headline value tracking every point.
move: A revenue card draws its area chart with a glowing tip while the headline counts up, then a hairline scrubs the curve with a live tooltip and the headline value tracking every point.
how: Monotone cubic path (no overshoot). Draw-on drives stroke-dashoffset, the area clip width and a glow dot from one progress value. Scrub x maps to y by binary search over a dense path sample; value is read back from y. Header number and month follow the scrub.
adapt: Replace DATA, MONTHS and MIN/MAX; formatting is in money(). Placeholder product names and copy are generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Timeline-driven: register the page's CustomEase curves, scope selectors to the shot and rebuild the timeline; state painted in onUpdate must stay a function of tl.time().
caveats: Original implementation; no third-party UI kit, product or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
